messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Paging: High rate of 429s observed for customer Skyline (vpc-dedicated pool skyline-01). Detected at 2026-03-15T15:24:16Z. Impact: request failures for production inference endpoints in eu-west-1. Pager oncall: @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: Saw the alert. Confirming — is this only for Skyline or other tenants in that pool?

sam_sre: Logs show token-bucket exhaustion for skyline-01 only. Error sample: `429 Too Many Requests - quota_exceeded` with header `x-rw-quota: 0/1000`. Dump: ```[2026-03-15T15:23:45Z] skyline-01 /generate 429 quota_exceeded tx=0.12s svc=runtime-gpu-1```

mina_am: Just on the account side — Skyline is in a committed enterprise contract with dedicated capacity and a soft quota cap. They hit an unexpected burst after a lighting campaign. They're escalated on our side and requesting immediate relief.

alice_oncall: OK. Triage plan: 1) Isolate tenant traffic routing to a spare node in the same pool (no noisy neighbor). 2) If isolation doesn't reduce 429s, request a temporary quota bump (hotfix override) for skyline-01 while we investigate. 3) Coordinate with AM for customer comms. Sam, can you run isolation step now?

sam_sre: Running routing change. Applying transient rule to pin skyline-01 to node id node-az1-13. Command: ```/srv/opsctl route-set --tenant skyline-01 --target node-az1-13 --reason "isolate noisy burst" --ttl 600s``` Will monitor logs for 60s.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: route change applied by sam_sre at 2026-03-15T15:25:10Z — node-az1-13. Healthcheck OK.

sam_sre: After routing, 429s dropped ~30% but still elevated. Token-bucket refill still lagging. Looks like Skyline's traffic pattern is very spiky — bursts exceed bucket size.

leo_eng: Quick mitigation we can do from control plane: temporary increase of per-tenant burst allowance via policy `hotfix_quota_bump`. Can do +3x burst for 10 minutes. Will require an approval tag. Suggest doing that while we continue throttling improvements.

alice_oncall: Mina, do we have permission to apply a hotfix quota increase for Skyline under enterprise escalation? Need explicit approval from AM or legal?

mina_am: I have verbal approval from Skyline Prod Eng (PM on call). I'll add a typed confirmation in this thread: "Skyline approves temporary +3x burst for 10m to mitigate production impact."

alice_oncall: Copy. Proceeding with hotfix. Applying policy change now: ```/srv/adminctl quota-bump --tenant skyline-01 --multiplier 3 --duration 600s --approved-by mina_am```

ops-bot: admin action recorded: quota-bump applied (id hb-9876) by alice_oncall at 2026-03-15T15:27:02Z.

sam_sre: Observing metrics — 429s dropped to acceptable baseline within 18s of bump. Latency stable. Opening a short-lived canary to ensure no cross-tenant leakage.

leo_eng: Creating an incident tag and scheduled work: we need to add stronger smoothing at the workload ingress (burst shaping + request queuing) and consider raising the committed burst allowance in contracts docs for marketing spikes.

mina_am: I'll notify Skyline support channel that we've applied a temporary quota bump and are doing a follow-up config change. Message to customer: "We've applied a temporary burst increase to maintain availability while we implement a safer smoothing fix. No data left your VPC. We'll follow up with timeline within 2 business hours."

alice_oncall: Handing off to sam_sre for remediation and post-incident follow-up. Oncall rotation ends in 30m — tagging next oncall. @sam_sre you own the postmortem and action items.

sam_sre: Ack. I'll collect traffic traces, kernel-level token-bucket stats, and the rule change audit. Drafting a short postmortem and mitigation plan: 1) safe smoothing at ingress 2) contract appendix for burst allowances 3) monitoring alert threshold tuning to avoid noisy early escalation. ETA for initial notes: 2h.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (temporary): skyline-01 quota-bump expired at 2026-03-15T15:37:02Z. Final status: traffic normalized. Follow-up task created: INC-2026-224 (owner: sam_sre).

mina_am: Thanks team. I'll coordinate customer follow-up and update the account playbook.

alice_oncall: Great job. Closing this thread but leaving actions open until postmortem is done. :white_check_mark:
